title: Thành phố không ngủ
about: Round x7, as the user asked ("hãy sáng tác thêm 2 bản nữa theo hướng khác"): a new direction, darkwave: a dark synth bass pulsing in eighths, a cold arpeggio, a soft steady beat and cold pads, a city at three in the morning; the glass sings a short tune over it in the middle. A minor at 96 bpm, about three and a half minutes. An original piece.
